## Summary

Describe the problem and the behavior of this change.

## Change Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build or tooling

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm run typecheck:lib`
- [ ] `pnpm run lint:lib`
- [ ] `pnpm run build`
- [ ] `pnpm run build:apidoc` when public API documentation changed

## Compatibility

- [ ] Existing public APIs, events, lifecycle timing, and Web Component tags remain compatible.
- [ ] Any intentional breaking change is clearly documented.

## Documentation and Safety

- [ ] Public documentation and examples are updated where required.
- [ ] The change contains no credentials, private data, internal infrastructure, or generated build output.
